# Steam — side-mission loop reported since 2019

- Original source: [Misiones chicas](https://steamcommunity.com/app/46560/discussions/0/1779388024830640142/)
- Author / publication: andres.contreras.d and respondents; Steam Community.
- Language / date: Spanish; opened 2019-02-04; replies through 2024-12-13.
- Access: Full thread retrieved directly (opening post and 6 replies)
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: lookup failed (archive.org rate limit); not checked
- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete post-by-post notes in English (Spanish Steam discussion, not transcribed)

The author reports being unable to reach what they call mission 26 because the game repeatedly requests smaller money-raising missions. Later players connect similar loops with Robin’s kidnapping: one sees the kidnapping announcement without a new mission, while another says Robin reappears in Sherwood by himself.

A reply also reports losing access to saves after a language change. The discussion provides no confirmed resolution. Its value is the early report and the differing campaign states, not verification of the author’s mission numbering or of one common cause.

5. **Flacolas** (13 Jul, 2024 @ 10:15pm), #4: tried the suggestion of changing the language, but their progress did not appear; when they switched back to Spanish they lost all their progress; asks whether anyone has a solution, including for recovering the old progress. 6. **aolave70** (16 Sep, 2024 @ 8:08pm), #5: same problem; stuck in the secondary missions; Robin was kidnapped but then appeared on his own in Sherwood.
